figurative_meaning_bn: যে কথার দ্বিতীয় অর্থ হয় না; অভিন্নমত
figurative_meaning_en: A statement without secondary or hidden meanings; unanimous agreement
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা সবসময় এককথা, কখনো দ্বি-অর্থক্ত নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: His words are always straightforward, never with double meanings.
Everyone agreed unanimously on the decision.
note: The idiom often implies consistency between thought and speech, as in the common phrase 'মনে মুখে এককথা'.
